```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Component;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;

class DashboardComponent extends Component
{
    // Public properties
    public $dailyJournalEntries = [];
    public $newEntryText = '';

    // Basic methods
    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.dashboard');
    }

    public function storeNewEntry()
    {
        if ($this->newEntryText) {
            // Logic to save the new entry
            $newEntry = [
                'user_id' => Auth::id(),
                'content' => $this->newEntryText,
                'created_at' => now(),
            ];

            // Simulate saving the entry
            sleep(1); // Simulating a delay for saving

            // Add the new entry to the dailyJournalEntries array
            array_push($this->dailyJournalEntries, $newEntry);

            // Reset the new entry text field
            $this->newEntryText = '';
        }
    }

    public function deleteDailyJournalEntry($index)
    {
        // Logic to delete a daily journal entry
        unset($this->dailyJournalEntries[$index]);

        // Optionally, you might want to save the updated list of entries
        // After deletion, call $this->saveDailyJournalEntries();
    }

    private function saveDailyJournalEntries()
    {
        // Logic to save the current state of daily journal entries to storage or database
        // This could be a simple file write or using Laravel's Eloquent ORM
    }
}
```
